explanation: A metronome set to 60 BPM ticks once a second. Beethoven was among the first composers to add metronome marks to his scores, from 1817.

claims.text: BPM stands for beats per minute.
BPM does not stand for bars per minute or beats per measure.
A metronome set to 60 beats per minute ticks once per second.
Beethoven was among the first composers to give metronome markings for his works, publishing marks for his symphonies in 1817.
